title: Stalks of a sectionwise filtered colimit of presheaves of modules are the filtered colimit of the stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of commutative rings on $X$ and $x\in X$. Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and $i\mapsto\mathcal P_i$ a diagram $\mathcal I\to\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)$ of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules on the open subsets of $X$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For every open $U\subseteq X$ let $(\mathcal P(U),(p_{i,U})_i)$ be a colimit of the diagram $i\mapsto\mathcal P_i(U)$ of $\mathcal O(U)$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and for opens $V\subseteq U$ let $\mathcal P(U)\to\mathcal P(V)$ be the map induced by the restriction maps of the $\mathcal P_i$, so that $\mathcal P$ is a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules and $p_i=(p_{i,U})_U:\mathcal P_i\to\mathcal P$ are morphisms of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules. Let $\mathcal O_x$, $(\mathcal P_i)_x$, $\mathcal P_x$ be the stalks at $x$, with the $\mathcal O_x$-module structures and the $\mathcal O_x$-linear stalk maps $(p_i)_x:(\mathcal P_i)_x\to\mathcal P_x$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then $(\mathcal P_x,((p_i)_x)_i)$ is a colimit of the diagram $i\mapsto(\mathcal P_i)_x$ in the category of $\mathcal O_x$-modules.

source.place: Sheaves, Section 009D (label section-limits-presheaves, lines 3367-3398), item (5): $(\colim_i\mathcal F_i)_x=\colim_i\mathcal F_{i,x}$ for presheaves, lines 3392-3396 ('The proofs are all easy'); used for modules in Modules, Lemma 01AH (label lemma-limits-colimits, lines 204-239), proof of (2) (modules.tex)

first query: none; second: instIsLeftAdjointPresheafStalkFunctor (Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Skyscraper): for C with colimits (and a terminal object) the stalk functor Presheaf C X => C is a left adjoint, hence preserves colimits; this is for presheaves valued in one fixed category C (e.g. abelian groups), not for presheaves of O-modules with the O_x-module structure on stalks

mathlib_searches.results: Stalk.lean only builds the O_x-module structure on stalks of a presheaf of modules (instance line 194, germ_smul line 205) and the module structure on filtered colimits (lines 41-136); Topology/Sheaves/Skyscraper.lean:395 instance (Presheaf.stalkFunctor C p0).IsLeftAdjoint; Abelian.lean:79 finite colimits; no file in ModuleCat/Sheaf mentions stalks; no lemma that the stalk of a colimit of presheaves of modules is the colimit of the stalks as O_x-modules

mathlib_candidate.declaration: instIsLeftAdjointPresheafStalkFunctor (with PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf_preservesColimitsOfSize and the O_x-module instance of Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Stalk.lean)
mathlib_candidate.how: Gives the statement for the underlying abelian groups (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x is a left adjoint, so preserves colimits; the underlying abelian presheaf of the sectionwise colimit is the colimit by toPresheaf_preservesColimitsOfSize). Passing to the colimit in O_x-modules needs that the O_x-module structure of Stalk.lean:194 on the colimit is the colimit one, which is a further argument, not a one-line specialization.
